result.title: Accounting Policy Manual - posting authority, support, approvals
result.text:
HALVARD SYSTEMS - ACCOUNTING POLICY MANUAL (excerpt), effective 2026-01-01
Applies to Halvard Systems Inc. (US), Halvard Systems Ltd (UK), Halvard Systems GmbH (DE).

1. Posting authority. Senior accountants may post manual journal entries up to USD 10,000
   per entry (local-currency entries are measured at the month-end rate of the entry month).
   Any entry above USD 10,000 must be routed to the Controller with an approval request
   (request_approval) immediately after posting; it remains pending until approved.
   Splitting one transaction into several entries to stay under the threshold is prohibited.
2. Support. Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry
   without support is not a valid entry.
3. Capitalization. Individual equipment purchases of USD 2,500 or more (local-currency
   equivalent at the month-end rate) are capitalized to 1500 Computer Equipment and
   depreciated over 36 months beginning the month after acquisition.
4. Prepaids. Payments covering services or events in future periods (more than one month
   out, or spanning more than one month) above USD 1,000 are recorded as prepaid (1210
   Prepaid Software for software, 1220 Prepaid Insurance for insurance, 1200 Prepaid Expenses
   for everything else, including deposits for future events) and expensed straight-line over
   the coverage period starting the month coverage begins, or when the event occurs.
5. Accruals. Expenses are recorded in the period the goods or services are received. Services
   received but not yet invoiced at month-end are accrued to 2100 Accrued Expenses using the
   best available evidence (vendor statements, approved timesheets, engagement terms).
   Quotes or proposals for future work are not liabilities.
6. Revenue. Revenue is recognized under ASC 606 per the contract terms. Deferred revenue
   (2200) is released as performance obligations are satisfied. Usage earned but not yet
   invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables.
7. Customer credits. SLA credits are issued only per contract terms and verified uptime data
   (see the monthly uptime report). Credits are recorded as a reduction of the related revenue.
8. Cash application. Customer receipts are applied to invoices per remittance advice. Receipts
   that cannot be matched to an open invoice remain in 2950 Unapplied Cash.
9. FX. Monetary balances denominated in a currency other than the entity's functional
   currency are remeasured at the month-end rate; gains/losses go to 6950 FX Gain/Loss.
   Intercompany charges are recorded by the receiving entity at the month-end rate of the
   month charged.
10. Payroll. Returned payroll deposits are recorded to 2150 Accrued Payroll & Unclaimed
   Wages until reissued. Unpaid wages at month-end are accrued to 2150.
11. Exceptions. Items that cannot be supported must be reported via flag_exception. Never
   post an entry to force a reconciliation or to make balances agree.
12. Periods. January and February 2026 are closed. March 2026 is open.

args.memo: Evergreen Bank implementation - recognize Milestone M1 (Solution design, 30% = $36,000) revenue upon signed customer acceptance 2026-03-14, per SOW (DOC-0047) and ASC 606 milestone/output method. Releases corresponding portion of deferred revenue (advance booked JE-00072).

args.reason: Entry amount ($36,000) exceeds the $10,000 senior-accountant posting threshold per Accounting Policy Manual (DOC-0005, item 1); routing to Controller for approval.

args.description: Evergreen Bank implementation Milestone M2 (Build & integration, 50% = $60,000) is not recognizable in March. Per SOW (DOC-0047), each milestone is a distinct performance obligation earned only upon the customer's written acceptance of that deliverable; the customer obtains no rights before acceptance. Per PM email DOC-0199 (2026-03-27), M2 is only ~80% built internally, customer UAT has not started, and nothing is signed - acceptance is targeted for late April. Recognizing revenue based on internal % complete would be inconsistent with the contract's output/milestone method and ASC 606. No revenue recognized for M2 in March; the $60,000 remains in Deferred Revenue (2200) until a signed M2 acceptance certificate is obtained. Flagging for awareness (not an error requiring correction) so it is not accidentally recognized before acceptance.

args.text:
EVERGREEN BANK IMPLEMENTATION - MARCH 2026 REVENUE RECOGNITION (ASC 606)

Contract facts (DOC-0047, SOW):
- Fixed-fee implementation, total USD 120,000, three distinct milestones, each separately accepted:
  M1 Solution design (30% / $36,000), M2 Build & integration (50% / $60,000), M3 UAT & go-live (20% / $24,000).
- Revenue terms are explicit: "each milestone is earned upon Customer's written acceptance of that deliverable. Customer has no obligation to pay for, and obtains no rights to, a deliverable before acceptance." This is an output-method/milestone contract, not a percentage-of-completion (input method) arrangement - internal completion % is not a recognition trigger.
- A non-refundable 50% advance ($60,000) was collected 2026-01-20 and booked entirely to Deferred Revenue (JE-00072); none of it had been released to revenue as of period-start (2200 balance -$60,000, no prior activity).

What was earned in March:
- M1 (Solution design) was formally accepted by the customer on 2026-03-14 per the signed Milestone Acceptance Certificate (DOC-0184). This satisfies the contractual recognition trigger for M1 ($36,000), and the deliverable is complete with no further performance obligation attached to it.
- Posted JE-00305 (2026-03-14, US): Dr 2200 Deferred Revenue $36,000 / Cr 4200 Professional Services Revenue $36,000. Support attached: DOC-0047 (SOW), DOC-0184 (M1 acceptance certificate). Because the entry exceeds the $10,000 senior-accountant posting threshold (Policy DOC-0005 §1), it was routed to the Controller via request_approval and is currently pending approval.

What was NOT recognized, and why:
- M2 (Build & integration, $60,000) is not earned. Per the PM status email (DOC-0199, 2026-03-27), M2 is only ~80% built internally, customer UAT has not started, and nothing has been signed; acceptance is targeted for late April. Under the contract's milestone/acceptance-based output method, no revenue can be recognized for M2 until a written acceptance is obtained - internal % complete is not a valid trigger here. I logged EXC-001 to flag this for controller visibility (informational - not an error) so the remaining $60,000 stays in Deferred Revenue (2200) and is not inadvertently recognized before acceptance.
- M3 ($24,000) has not started and is likewise unrecognized (not flagged separately, as this is undisputed/no activity yet).

Resulting deferred revenue rollforward (US, Evergreen implementation):
- Beginning balance: $60,000 (full advance, deferred)
- Less: M1 released to revenue (JE-00305): ($36,000)
- Ending Deferred Revenue balance: $24,000 (attributable to unearned M2/M3 milestones; consistent since only $36,000 of the $60,000 advance has a satisfied performance obligation so far - the remaining $24,000 will stay deferred until M2/M3 are accepted, at which point additional invoicing/deferred revenue may also be needed for amounts above the advance).

Checklist: marked "Revenue recognition" (US) as in_progress - not complete, pending (a) Controller approval of JE-00305 and (b) M2 acceptance evidence expected in April.

No other items require action for this project this period; the recurring monthly subscription revenue (invoices INV-2104/2109/2114 to account 4000) is unrelated to this SOW and was already recognized correctly on a monthly basis.
